approved_mapping.region: Front stepped opaque masses: right tower y=-34, left blocks y=-35, tall entrance screen y=-33
approved_mapping.limit: Family only, not measured tile/panel color or joints. Use coherent original planes; never create a two-tone triangle to imitate photographed shading.

approved_mapping.region: Left projecting block right-facing return x=-15 where exposed beside central glazing
approved_mapping.limit: 2925 directly shows this return. Do not extend to all external side/rear faces merely by component name; omitted side slits not added.

approved_mapping.region: Central exposed wall between original glazing recesses y=-27 and original projecting mullions
approved_mapping.limit: Apply only existing central face domains and original mullions, not the large forward entrance screen or tower wall. Upper wider glazing field included only where existing facets define it.

approved_mapping.region: Existing central, vertical-strip and slit-window recess backs
approved_mapping.family: subdued gray-green / dark neutral reflective shade
approved_mapping.limit: Keep separate backs, not continuous glass over spandrels/opaque masses. Fine source window subdivision not reconstructed.

approved_mapping.region: Tall left recess x=-36..-18, z57..88: inner soffit/side wall and backing y approximately -24.5
approved_mapping.family: muted shadowed warm gray/neutral inner skin; separate existing nine small window backs gray-green
approved_mapping.limit: Source photographs show shadowed opaque return surfaces and gridded backing, not a wholly black glazed void. Avoid assigning entire recess volume a glass material.

approved_mapping.region: Existing pale entrance support column and visible front screen frame
approved_mapping.limit: No added doors/railings/signs; source ground surroundings partly tree-obscured. Original 3 lower window backs can receive restrained gray-green family, not fabricated detailed entry fittings.

mandatory_limits: Only exterior same-item color interpretation; original proportions, floor counts and window placement remain coarse and are not revalidated as exact.
Three photographs overlap the front; not a complete four-side material survey.
Do not borrow adjacent hospital, sculpture, landscape, vehicles or other buildings.
Source lighting/shadow is not calibrated material color; upload dates not assumed capture/current-condition date.
Original photos and pages remain private; retain source author/credit and applicable noncommercial restrictions; no commercial-rights guarantee.
No physical print or multi-filament slicing validation implied.
